Name: Kadmiel
Summary: A Levite who oversaw the temple work, taught the Law, and sealed the covenant.
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:40; Ezra 3:9; Nehemiah 7:43; Nehemiah 9:4; Nehemiah 10:9; Nehemiah 12:8
LifeLesson: Steady service in worship and in teaching holds a community together.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Rebuilding of the Temple; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
